correctness.rationale: After n steps at x, white count 1+(n-x)/2, blue count (n+x)/2, hence P(next x+1)=(n+2-x)/(2(n+1)); on survival x>=1 this is <=1/2. The killed first moment A_n=nE[X_n 1_{tau>n}] satisfies the EXACT identity A_{n+1}=A_n+u_n with u_n=P(tau>n), because a move from x=1 to zero carries zero weighted mass. Coupling surviving paths to a fair simple random walk above them, and reflection principle, gives u_{2n}<=2A_n/[n sqrt(n+1)]. Since u_n decreases, u_j<=b_j A_floor(j/2), b_j=O(j^-3/2) summable. Choose J with sum_{j>=J}b_j<=1/2: A_{N+1}<=A_J+(1/2)A_{N+1}, so A_n bounded; hence u_n=O(n^-3/2) and E tau<infinity. Independent exact rational killed-chain DP verified recurrence, mass, monotonicity to 70 steps (u70~0.01655614). Finite DP does not prove infinite tail.
residual_risks: The exponent 3/2 is only an upper decay rate, not a matching asymptotic; no result for arbitrary urn inventories or 2D.
